title: One float, three layouts: sign, exponent, mantissa
why: It shows the actual bit fields the prose names in sequence, drawn to scale, so the trade is visible: bf16 keeps fp32's exponent range and gives up mantissa bits, which is why it replaces fp32 without a scaling factor.
caption: fp16: sign 1, exponent 5, mantissa 10. bf16: sign 1, exponent 8, mantissa 7. fp16 tops out at 65,504; bf16 reaches fp32’s range with fewer mantissa bits.
